project.title: punchCraft Puncheokie
project.description: Android-first Expo app reviving FightCamp v1 BLE punch trackers.

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Phase-level container. Do not open ad-hoc; issues are its sub-issues.

labels.name: story
labels.description: Vertical slice large enough to demonstrate against hardware or a user.

labels.name: task
labels.description: Concrete unit of engineering work; usually a few hours to a day.

labels.name: spike
labels.description: Time-boxed investigation; deliverable is a decision, not shipped code.

labels.name: phase:0
labels.description: Phase 0 — Preserve the baseline and establish the repository

labels.name: phase:2
labels.description: Phase 2 — Protocol initialization, decoding, and synchronization

labels.name: phase:5
labels.description: Phase 5 — Puncheokie program engine without Spotify

labels.name: area:protocol
labels.description: FightCamp v1 protocol adapter and replay

labels.name: area:puncheokie
labels.description: Puncheokie program engine and cue runner

labels.name: P0
labels.description: Blocks the sprint or an MVP capability

labels.name: hardware-required
labels.description: Cannot be executed without the physical tablet or trackers

labels.name: go-no-go
labels.description: Decision gate; result determines whether subsequent work proceeds

labels.name: policy-review
labels.description: Requires Spotify or other policy/legal review before enabling

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on another issue, decision, or external event

milestones.title: M01: Baseline preserved & official-app captures archived
milestones.description: Tablet + tracker inventory recorded (model, Android release, API level, Bluetooth chipset); trackers labeled blue=left/red=right; official-app HCI snoop logs + screen recordings archived on the Windows PC. Spec §12.2, §22 Phase 0.

milestones.title: M02: Installable Expo development build
milestones.description: TS-strict Expo project, dev-client build installs over USB, build-info screen, known-good APK archived, exact Expo/RN/BLE-library versions locked after Story 1 spike. Spec §11.2, §22 Phase 0, §23 Story 1.

milestones.title: M03: BLE permissions & Bluetooth-state onboarding
milestones.description: First-launch explainer, denied/permanently-denied → settings, Bluetooth-off distinguished from permission denial, neverForLocation decision. Spec §11.3, §23 Story 2.

milestones.title: M04: Bounded scan & advertisement capture
milestones.description: TrackerScanner bounded 10–15 s, stop-on-found, dedup summary preserves latest RSSI/manufacturer bytes, JSON export. Spec §11.6, §23 Story 3.

milestones.title: M05: Single-tracker connect & GATT inventory
milestones.description: BleManagerFacade + TrackerConnection state machine with generation counter, GattOperationQueue serialized, GATT inspector, device fingerprint + manual L/R assignment. Spec §11.4, §11.5, §11.7, §11.8, §11.10, §23 Story 4.

milestones.title: M06: Notification subscription & raw-frame persistence
milestones.description: NotificationRouter subscribes to safe notify/indicate characteristics, RawBleFrame persisted BEFORE parsing, listener ring buffer throttled 5–10 Hz, DB write-backlog indicator. Spec §11.9, §12.4, §7.2B, §23 Story 5.

milestones.title: M07: Observation markers & JSON capture export
milestones.description: Marker model on the same monotonic base as frames, mark UI with label picker, CaptureExporter JSON, Windows-side correlation script. Spec §23 Story 6.

milestones.title: M08: Disconnect / reconnect resilience
milestones.description: Immediate disconnect detection, recovering state with bounded backoff and re-subscription, foreground-only policy: keep-awake + background warning. Spec §11.5, §11.11, §19.3.

milestones.title: M09: Dual-tracker concurrent connections
milestones.description: TrackerCoordinator with independent L/R state machines, aggregate state, frames tagged with device/hand, disconnecting one leaves the other untouched. Spec §11.5, §23 Story 7.

milestones.title: M10: First repeatable punch frame captured (go/no-go)
milestones.description: ≥3 identical single-punch tests per hand vs no-motion baseline; repeatable frame/sequence identified; saved as a replay fixture; third-party feasibility go/no-go recorded. Spec §23 Story 8, §24.

milestones.title: M11: Initialization plan from observed traffic
milestones.description: Only observed writes implemented; ProtocolAdapter + ProtocolRegistry contracts. Spec §12.3, §22 Phase 2 tasks 1–2.

milestones.title: M12: FightCampV1Adapter skeleton & device status decoding
milestones.description: Versioned adapter; device status decoding drives capability detection; endianness/fixed-point unit tests. Spec §12.3, §21.1, §22 Phase 2 tasks 3–4.

milestones.title: M13: Punch-event decoding: boundaries, hand, sequence, timestamp
milestones.description: Deterministic TrackerPunchEvent (§12.5) for controlled L/R punches; sequence wraparound vs reset. Spec §12.5, §22 Phase 2 tasks 5–7.

milestones.title: M14: Velocity & punch-type field analysis, capability detection
milestones.description: Slow/normal/fast set analysis, punch-type field analysis, tracker_capabilities populated with confidence, tracker-units labeling. Spec §4.2, §4.3, §22 Phase 2 tasks 8–9, 13.

milestones.title: M15: Session start/stop, offline sync, dedup & gap handling
milestones.description: Observed session commands, offline-sync path with recovered flag and last-synced sequence, sequence-based dedup with heuristic fallback that never deletes raw frames. Spec §12.6, §22 Phase 2 tasks 10–11.

milestones.title: M16: Replay harness & fixture test suite
milestones.description: ReplayRunner on Windows without BLE hardware; every confirmed capture a fixture with expected messages; malformed/truncated/unknown-field fixtures included. Spec §12.7, §21.2, §22 Phase 2 task 12.

milestones.title: M17: Calibration session & guided punch sets
milestones.description: State machine and guided flow (10 s idle → 10 low → 10 normal → 10 fast per hand), sample accept/reject, distribution + L/R comparison. Spec §10.1 Layer 3, §22 Phase 3 tasks 1–3.

milestones.title: M18: Versioned calibration profiles & stale detection
milestones.description: CalibrationProfile model + repository, robust percentile computation, zone thresholds, activation/revert, staleness rules. Spec §10.2, §10.3, §10.4, §22 Phase 3 tasks 4–7.

milestones.title: M19: Live validation round & calibration report
milestones.description: 30-s validation with active profile; calibration report export. Spec §22 Phase 3 tasks 8–9.

milestones.title: M20: Session/timer engine
milestones.description: §18.1 state machine with monotonic clock, pause semantics (duringPause flag), timer/acceptance/pause/clock-change tests. Spec §18, §22 Phase 4 tasks 1–2, 7.

milestones.title: M21: Readiness gate & live metric tiles
milestones.description: Pre-session readiness with explicit degraded warnings; large glanceable tiles and pop-out tile customization. Spec §8.2, §8.3, §22 Phase 4 tasks 3–4, 12.

milestones.title: M22: Session persistence & deterministic metrics
milestones.description: sessions/rounds/punch_events/session_metrics; MetricsEngine confirmed + velocity-dependent metrics with calculation_version; in-session reconnect updates completeness. Spec §9, §17, §22 Phase 4 tasks 8–9.

milestones.title: M23: Summary, history, recalculation & export
milestones.description: Session summary discloses velocity representation; history with filter/detail/compare/delete; recalculation with newer decoder/profile; CSV + JSON export. Spec §8.5, §8.6, §22 Phase 4 tasks 10–11.

milestones.title: M24: Program model & editor
milestones.description: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-23 by M31 (Puncheokie v0.2, docs/puncheokie-ux-workout-engine.md). Milestone closed; its issues were closed as superseded.

milestones.title: M25: Stance mapping & cue runner
milestones.description: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-23 by M32 (Puncheokie v0.2). Retains only the StanceMapper issues M25-01 and M25-02.

milestones.title: M26: Cue matching & capability-aware scoring
milestones.description: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-23 by M33 (Puncheokie v0.2). Retains only the CueMatcher/scoring/fixture issues M26-01, M26-02 and M26-04.

milestones.title: M27: Spotify PKCE authorization & secure tokens
milestones.description: Dev app registered; redirect URI + Android package configured; SpotifyAuthService PKCE via expo-auth-session; SpotifyTokenStore in SecureStore; minimum scopes; 401/403/429 handling. Spec §14.2, §14.3, §14.8, §22 Phase 6 tasks 1–6.

milestones.title: M28: Playlist selection, caching & deep link
milestones.description: Paginated fetch tolerating unavailable playlist items; playlist picker + local metadata cache; Android content deep link into Spotify app; disconnect/erase; log redaction. Spec §14.4, §14.7, §22 Phase 6 tasks 7–11.

milestones.title: M29: Endurance, reliability & storage retention
milestones.description: 1-hour endurance runs; retention controls with pin-capture + storage-usage display; crash-reporting decision; log field classification; anonymized export. Spec §17.2, §19, §20.4, §22 Phase 7 tasks 1–4.

milestones.title: M30: Release readiness
milestones.description: Release signing + backup APK; dependency lock + SBOM; accessibility + landscape pass; in-app safety/privacy disclosures; protocol-compatibility report; user documentation; Spotify policy/legal decision; MVP release gate met. Spec §19.4, §19.5, §20, §21.6, §22 Phase 7 tasks 5–11.

milestones.title: M31: Workout model, recipe & persistence
milestones.description: Workout contracts (tokens, blocks, recipe, schedule, goals, cadence), hand-authored sample workouts, the Workout Recipe screen replacing the editor, and SQLite persistence for recipes, generated workouts, adaptations, and cue results. Doc §2, §4, §8–§12, §17, §26; spec §13.4, §17.1, §15.1. Supersedes M24.

milestones.title: M32: Cue engine & landscape live screen on simulated events
milestones.description: PunchEventSource port + simulated source, capability tier + label, cue-timeline expansion with clamped windows, the doc §20 cue lifecycle composed with the §18.1 SessionEngine, token visual grammar, and the landscape four-zone live screen driven by simulated events. Doc §5, §13, §14, §19–§21; spec §13.2, §13.5, §18, §19.4. Supersedes M25 except M25-01/M25-02.

milestones.title: M33: Tracker matching, pacing & round results
milestones.description: Real tracker stream wired into the live screen, CueMatcher integration with per-punch feedback, round grading with text + icon badges, three-phase rest, PacingEngine, volume-burst/open-pressure blocks with goal allocation, goal-seeking with persisted adaptations, and the workout summary persisting cue_results; every sequence score is labeled hand-sequence match. Doc §3, §6, §9, §10, §14, §21–§24; spec §13.3, §13.6, §8.5, §8.6. Supersedes M26 except M26-01/M26-02/M26-04.

milestones.title: M34: Voice Coach
milestones.description: Policy-gated Voice Coach: tablet spike on playback latency and audio focus, domain VoiceOutputPort + VoiceCoachPolicy + CueAnnouncer scheduled by the cue clock, Expo audio infrastructure, and settings with the third-party-playback opt-in defaulting OFF (D1). Doc §5, §18, §25; spec §13.5, §14.6, §15.1.

milestones.title: M35: Combo library & procedural generator
milestones.description: ComboTemplate contract, seeded PRNG, starter and expanded (40–60) combo libraries with rule validation, round-theme planner, constraint-based WorkoutGenerator with determinism guarantees, wired into the Recipe screen with Surprise Me. Doc §7, §11, §15–§17; spec §14.6.

milestones.title: M36: Presets, replay & bag validation
milestones.description: Saved recipe presets and Run This Exact Workout Again (seed + generator version reuse), the audio/visual sync test with Spotify in the background, and the bag-testing protocol that tunes graces, windows, cadence, and density ceilings. Doc §8, §16, §24, §27 steps 13–15; spec §21.4, §14.6.

milestones.title: M37: Strike confirmation, combo plausibility & gratification
milestones.description: Per-strike node flash with a four-cue haptic vocabulary, the progressive combo affirmation border, the capability-aware five-signal plausibility model with four confidence tiers, bounded gratification levels with a Focus mode, and combo_results persistence versioned by CONFIDENCE_VERSION. Signals the tracker cannot supply are omitted, never zeroed; every label stays hand-sequence match. Doc §28, §13, §21, §25; spec §13.3, §17.1, §19.4, §22 Phase 5 task 15 (D4, D11).
